actions: Implemented a reservation-aware fail-closed auditor over the main scientific journal plus one-attempt reservation ledger.
Validated mixed compliance states, all torn COMMIT cuts, and 5,000 randomized fail-closed mixtures with zero optimism violations.

Implemented a superseding compliance-aware CLOSE/replay layer that embeds and rederives the audit, requires recovery COMMIT before closing a bound SLOT, and forces bypass/noncompliant planned SLOTs to score 1.
Validated all 2,633 nonempty torn CLOSE cuts, tamper rejection with recomputed outer frames, legacy-then-compliance mixed replay, and missing-COMMIT reconciliation gating.
Persisted source, validation, checkpoint and advanced role-local LATEST with CAS/readback.

termination.blocker: Compliance CLOSE is not yet deployable through the old launch-capability/runtime replay binding; a superseding gate must use the compliance replay state after a new-format CLOSE.
termination.exact_next_action: Implement a compliance-aware launch-capability gate whose capability verification and post-close recovery call reservation_compliance_close_replay rather than the legacy adapter, while still acknowledging the legacy-format ADMIT frame. Then validate a two-block lifecycle where block 1 contains a durable lower-level bypass SLOT that is forced to failure=1 at compliance CLOSE and block 2 can still be admitted/launched after restart without reporter-state divergence.
